title: A Hypotenuse-Angle Axiomatization of the Hilbert Plane
summary: We show that, in $\MG^{-}$ --- $\MG$, the Hilbert plane, deprived of the Side-Angle-Side axiom --- a hypotenuse-angle criterion for right triangles, together with the existence of a perpendicular from an external point to a line and a ray correspondence principle governing the ordering of angles, suffices to reconstruct SAS in full --- and hence, as standard consequences, SSS and SAA as well. This offers a more elementary alternative to Hilbert's own choice of SAS as an axiom, confined throughout to right triangles and provable without any continuity assumption.
